senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חלל) [to turn around, circle,]
to dance. Part. חָל, חוֹל; perf. חָל.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 4:8">Taan. IV, 8</cite> <he>יוצאות וחוֹלוֹת וכ׳</he> used to go out and dance in the vineyards; Lam. R. introd. <he>וחָלוֹת</he> (<he>ר׳ זעירא</he>) (ed. Wil. <he>וחולות</he>).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:11:1">Koh. R. to I, 11</cite> <he>חָלִין לפניו</he> dance before Him, v. <cite ref="H00334"><he>חוֹלָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> <cite ref="H01050"><he>חָלִים</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:1">Cant. R. to VII, 1</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: (cmp. חַג) to come in turn, to occur.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:1">Meg. I, 1</cite> <he>חל להיות וכ׳</he> if the fourteenth fell on a Monday.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:1">R. Hash. IV, 1</cite>; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: (with על) to hover around one’s head, to rest upon one as a duty; to take effect (as a law).
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 25a:11">Shebu. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>הנדרים חָלִים על וכ׳</he> vows are binding even if referring to a religious obligation.
<cite ref="Shevuot 25a">Ib.</cite> <he>שבועות חָלוֹת וכ׳</he> oaths are binding &c.; <cite ref="Nedarim 15a">Ned. 15ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Nedarim 17a:4">Ib. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>אין חָלָה וכ׳</he> one vow of nazaritism does not take effect &c.; <cite ref="Chullin 101a:6">Ḥull. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>איסור חל וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01405"><he>אִיסּוּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:1:2">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᵃ</cite> top; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: [to be made to circle,] to be commenced, established.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 31a">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="H01028"><he>הוּחֲלָה</he></cite> it (prayer at fixed times) was instituted.
